repos.summary_en: Superpowers is an agentic software development framework built on composable 'skills' that guide coding agents through a complete workflow—from idea refinement and design validation to TDD-driven implementation via subagent-driven development. It automates planning, branching, testing, and execution across platforms like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex, enforcing best practices like YAGNI, DRY, and red/green testing.

repos.summary_en: n8n is a secure workflow automation platform combining visual building with custom code (JavaScript/Python), offering 400+ integrations, native AI capabilities via LangChain, and flexible deployment options—self-hosted or cloud—under a fair-code license for full data control and extensibility.

repos.summary_en: Prompts.chat is the world's largest open-source prompt library for AI models like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. It offers a community-driven platform to share, discover, and collect prompts, with free public access and self-hosting options for organizations seeking privacy.

repos.summary_en: Dify is a production-ready platform for agentic workflow development, enabling visual orchestration, multi-model integration, and automated process building for enterprise AI application development.

repos.description: Langflow is a powerful tool for building and deploying AI-powered agents and workflows.
repos.summary_zh: Langflow 是一个强大的 AI 智能体与工作流构建平台，提供可视化拖拽界面和 Python 源码级定制能力。支持多智能体编排、API/MCP 部署、LangSmith 可观测性集成，内置主流 LLM 与向量数据库支持，适用于企业级 AI 应用快速开发与部署。
repos.summary_en: Langflow is a powerful platform for building and deploying AI-powered agents and workflows. It offers a visual builder interface, source code customization in Python, multi-agent orchestration, API/MCP deployment, LangSmith observability, and native support for major LLMs and vector databases, making it ideal for rapid enterprise-grade AI application development.

repos.description: The agent engineering platform.
repos.summary_zh: LangChain 是一个构建可靠 AI 智能体的框架，提供标准化的 LLM、嵌入、向量存储等组件接口，支持实时数据增强、模型互操作性和快速原型开发，助力开发者高效构建生产级 LLM 应用。
repos.summary_en: LangChain is a framework for building reliable AI agents and LLM-powered applications. It offers standardized interfaces for models, embeddings, and vector stores, enabling real-time data augmentation, model interoperability, and rapid prototyping for production-ready AI solutions.

(And other Open Sourced) System Prompts, Internal Tools & AI Models

repos.summary_en: This repository contains over 30,000 lines of insights into system prompts, internal tools, and AI models of major AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Devin AI), offering deep technical analysis of their architecture, functionality, and design principles for developers seeking to understand and leverage AI-powered development tools.

repos.description: Use Garry Tan's exact Claude Code setup: 23 opinionated tools that serve as CEO, Designer, Eng Manager, Release Manager, Doc Engineer, and QA
repos.summary_zh: gstack 是 Garry Tan（YC 创始人）基于 Claude Code 构建的 AI 工程团队工具集，集成 CEO、设计师、工程师、发布经理等 15 个角色，通过 slash 命令实现产品规划、代码审查、QA 测试、安全审计和自动化部署。支持每日 1-2 万行代码的高效开发，适用于技术型创始人、Claude Code 新手及资深技术负责人。
repos.summary_en: gstack is Garry Tan's (YC President) AI-powered engineering toolkit built on Claude Code, featuring 15 specialized roles including CEO, designer, eng manager, and QA. It enables ultra-high productivity coding through slash commands for planning, review, testing, security audits, and deployment—ideal for technical founders, Claude Code beginners, and senior tech leads.

repos.description: An open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal.
repos.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 是一款开源 AI 智能体，将 Gemini 的强大功能直接集成到终端中，提供对 Gemini 3 模型的轻量级访问，支持 Google 搜索、文件操作、Shell 命令等内置工具，并具备 MCP 扩展能力，专为命令行开发者设计，采用 Apache 2.0 许可。
repos.summary_en: Gemini CLI is an open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal, offering lightweight access to Gemini 3 models with built-in tools like Google Search, file operations, and shell commands, plus extensibility via MCP (Model Context Protocol), designed for developers who live in the command line.

repos.description: 🔥 The Web Data API for AI - Turn entire websites into LLM-ready markdown or structured data
repos.summary_zh: Firecrawl 是一个专为 AI 设计的网页数据 API，可将任意网站转换为 LLM 可直接使用的结构化数据（如 Markdown、JSON、截图等），支持 JavaScript 渲染、动态内容抓取、批量处理和内容变更监控，显著提升 AI 应用的数据获取效率与准确性。
repos.summary_en: Firecrawl is a web data API designed for AI, converting any website into LLM-ready structured data (e.g., Markdown, JSON, screenshots). It supports JavaScript rendering, dynamic content extraction, batch processing, and change tracking, significantly enhancing data acquisition for AI applications.

repos.description: 🤯 LobeHub - Super-Agents on Your Team. Add super-agents to the chats your team already uses.They take on work by themselves and get better every week.
repos.summary_zh: LobeHub 是一个面向工作与生活的终极协作空间，致力于构建人类与智能体协同进化的网络。该平台支持多智能体协作、无代码团队设计，并提供智能搜索、知识库、语音交互、插件系统等强大功能，打造下一代 AI 驱动的生产力工具生态。
repos.summary_en: LobeHub is the ultimate workspace for human-agent collaboration, enabling multi-agent teamwork, effortless agent orchestration, and co-evolution between humans and AI. It features smart search, knowledge bases, voice interaction, plugin systems, and a growing ecosystem of agent teammates designed to enhance productivity.

repos.description: 🌐 Make websites accessible for AI agents. Automate tasks online with ease.
repos.summary_zh: Browser-Use 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的网页自动化框架，通过 LLM 驱动浏览器完成复杂在线任务。支持主流大模型（Gemini、Claude 等），提供 stealth 模式云浏览器服务，实现高效、隐蔽的网页交互与数据采集，适用于自动化测试、信息抓取等场景。
repos.summary_en: Browser-Use is an AI agent framework that enables LLM-driven automation of web tasks. It supports major LLMs (Gemini, Claude, etc.) and offers stealth cloud browsers for secure, scalable automation. Ideal for web scraping, testing, and data collection with seamless integration.

repos.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
repos.summary_zh: Everything Claude Code 是一个专为 AI 智能体性能优化设计的完整系统，涵盖技能、直觉、记忆、安全和研究优先的开发。它支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cowork 等平台，提供生产级代理、钩子、命令、规则和 MCP 配置，适用于多语言环境，是 Anthropic 黑客马拉松获奖作品。
repos.summary_en: Everything Claude Code is a comprehensive performance optimization system for AI agent harnesses, featuring skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development. It supports Claude Code, Codex, Cowork, and more, offering production-ready agents, hooks, commands, rules, and MCP configurations, evolved over 10+ months of real-world use.

repos.description: 💫 Toolkit to help you get started with Spec-Driven Development
repos.summary_zh: Spec Kit 是一个开源工具包，专注于规格驱动开发（Spec-Driven Development），通过将规格转化为可执行代码，帮助开发者快速构建高质量软件。它提供 CLI 工具、AI 助手集成和项目治理框架，支持从零开始或现有项目初始化，显著提升开发效率并减少‘ vibe coding’。
repos.summary_en: Spec Kit is an open-source toolkit for Spec-Driven Development, transforming specifications into executable code to accelerate high-quality software creation. It offers CLI tools, AI agent integration, and project governance via `/speckit.constitution` and `/speckit.specify` commands, enabling rapid project initialization and reducing ad-hoc coding.

repos.description: RAGFlow is a leading open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine that fuses cutting-edge RAG with Agent capabilities to create a superior context layer for LLMs
repos.summary_zh: RAGFlow 是一款领先的开放源代码检索增强生成（RAG）引擎，深度融合 RAG 与 Agent 能力，为大型语言模型构建卓越的上下文层。它提供简洁高效的 RAG 工作流，适用于各类规模企业，支持多语言文档处理、智能问答、知识库构建及 Agent 驱动任务自动化。
repos.summary_en: RAGFlow is a leading open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine that seamlessly integrates advanced RAG with Agent capabilities to build superior context layers for LLMs. It delivers a streamlined, scalable workflow ideal for enterprises, supporting multilingual document processing, intelligent Q&A, knowledge base construction, and agent-driven task automation.

repos.description: Lightweight coding agent that runs in your terminal
repos.summary_zh: OpenAI Codex CLI 是一款轻量级终端编码智能体，支持本地运行代码生成与编辑。通过 npm 或 Homebrew 一键安装，集成 ChatGPT 账户体系，提供 IDE 插件及桌面应用扩展，适用于开发者快速实现自动化编程任务。
repos.summary_en: Codex CLI is a lightweight coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your computer. Install via npm or Homebrew, sign in with ChatGPT, and use it in terminal, IDEs like VS Code, or as a desktop app for automated code generation and editing.

repos.description: A programming framework for agentic AI
repos.summary_zh: AutoGen 是微软开源的多智能体 AI 编程框架，支持构建自主或人机协作的智能应用。它提供灵活的代理设计、多代理协同机制及与 MCP 等工具的深度集成，适用于复杂任务编排、自动化工作流和交互式 AI 系统开发。
repos.summary_en: AutoGen is an open-source framework for building multi-agent AI applications that can operate autonomously or collaborate with humans. It enables flexible agent design, orchestration, and integration with tools like MCP, supporting complex workflows, automation, and interactive AI systems.

repos.description: Autonomous coding agent right in your IDE, capable of creating/editing files, executing commands, using the browser, and more with your permission every step of the way.
repos.summary_zh: Cline 是一款集成在 IDE 中的自主编码代理，基于 Claude Sonnet 的代理能力，支持文件创建/编辑、终端命令执行、浏览器操作等，全程需用户授权。通过 AST 分析、正则搜索和上下文管理，可处理复杂开发任务，支持 MCP 扩展工具，提供安全的 AI 编程辅助。
repos.summary_en: Cline is an autonomous coding agent integrated directly into your IDE, powered by Claude Sonnet's agentic capabilities. It can create/edit files, execute terminal commands, use browsers, and more—with your permission at every step. Designed for complex software development tasks through AST analysis, regex searches, and context-aware workflows, it extends functionality via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) while maintaining human oversight for safety.

repos.description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
repos.summary_zh: CLI-Anything 致力于将任意软件转化为原生 AI 智能体工具，通过统一接口桥接 AI 代理与真实世界软件。支持一键安装社区构建的 CLI 工具，提供 OpenClaw、Cursor 等平台兼容方案，覆盖 16+ 应用并实现 1839 项测试全通过。核心功能包括自动化注册、元技能发现及 JSON/人类可读双输出格式。
repos.summary_en: CLI-Anything enables any software to become agent-native, bridging AI agents with real-world tools via standardized interfaces. Features one-command installation from the community-driven CLI-Hub, compatibility with platforms like Cursor and Claude Code, support for 16+ applications, and 100% test pass rate (1,839 tests). Includes automated registry updates, meta-skill discovery, and dual JSON/human-readable output formats.

repos.description: The all-in-one AI productivity accelerator. On device and privacy first with no annoying setup or configration.
repos.summary_zh: AnythingLLM 是一款全栈式桌面与 Docker AI 应用，集成 RAG、AI 智能体、无代码智能体构建器及 MCP 兼容性，支持多用户管理与权限控制，提供灵活 LLM 与向量数据库配置，实现文档智能对话与自动化处理。
repos.summary_en: AnythingLLM is a full-stack desktop and Docker-based AI application featuring built-in RAG, AI agents, no-code agent builder, and MCP compatibility. It supports customizable LLMs and vector databases, multi-user management, and seamless document interaction for intelligent chat and automation.

repos.description: Build AI Agents, Visually
repos.summary_zh: Flowise 是一个可视化 AI 智能体构建平台，支持通过拖拽方式快速搭建 LLM 应用流程。它提供图形化界面集成主流大模型、向量数据库和工具节点，支持本地部署与云端服务，适用于开发者和企业快速原型开发与生产部署。
repos.summary_en: Flowise is a visual platform for building AI agents and LLM applications using drag-and-drop workflows. It integrates major LLMs, vector databases, and tools via a no-code interface, supporting both self-hosted and cloud deployment for rapid prototyping and production use.

repos.description: CLI platform to experiment with codegen. Precursor to: https://lovable.dev
repos.summary_zh: gpt-engineer 是一个基于 CLI 的代码生成实验平台，支持通过自然语言描述需求，由 AI 自动生成并执行代码，并可迭代优化。它支持 OpenAI API、本地模型及 Azure 等多种模型，提供项目创建、代码改进和自定义代理基准测试功能，是早期 AI 编程工具的重要探索。
repos.summary_en: gpt-engineer is a CLI platform for experimenting with AI-driven code generation. It allows users to specify software in natural language, watch an AI write and execute code, and iteratively improve it. Supports OpenAI, local models, and Azure, with features for project creation, code improvement, and benchmarking custom agents.

repos.description: Your AI workspace for models, agents, and productivity.
repos.summary_zh: Cherry Studio 是一款 AI 生产力工作室，集成智能聊天、自主代理和300+助手，提供统一接口访问主流大语言模型，支持多语言界面与跨平台部署，适用于个人及企业级智能工作流构建。
repos.summary_en: Cherry Studio is an AI productivity studio featuring smart chat, autonomous agents, and 300+ assistants with unified access to leading LLMs. It supports multi-language interfaces and cross-platform deployment for building intelligent workflows at personal or enterprise level.

repos.description: LlamaIndex is the leading document agent and OCR platform
repos.summary_zh: LlamaIndex 是一个领先的文档智能代理与 OCR 平台，专为构建基于大模型的文档应用而设计。它提供数据连接、索引、查询与可视化能力，支持多模态输入与复杂推理，广泛应用于知识库问答、文档分析与智能检索等场景。
repos.summary_en: LlamaIndex is a leading document agent and OCR platform designed for building LLM-powered document applications. It enables data ingestion, indexing, querying, and visualization, supporting multimodal inputs and complex reasoning for use cases like knowledge base QA, document analysis, and intelligent retrieval.

repos.description: A curated list of awesome Claude Skills, resources, and tools for customizing Claude AI workflows
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Claude Skills 是一个精心策划的 Claude AI 技能库，涵盖文档处理、开发工具、数据分析、商业营销等十大领域。通过 Composio 插件，Claude 可连接500+应用执行真实操作（如发邮件、创建工单），实现从文本生成到自动化工作的跨越。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Claude Skills is a curated collection of practical workflows for enhancing Claude AI across platforms. It covers document processing, development tools, data analysis, business automation, and more. With the Composio plugin, Claude can connect to 500+ apps to perform real-world actions like sending emails or creating issues, extending beyond text generation.

repos.description: Open Multi-Agent Interactive Classroom — Get an immersive, multi-agent learning experience in just one click
repos.summary_zh: OpenMAIC 是一个开源的多智能体交互式学习平台，通过 AI 教师和同学实时互动，将任意主题或文档转化为沉浸式课堂体验。支持一键生成课件、测验、白板演示及项目式学习活动，集成 OpenClaw 实现从飞书、Slack 等消息应用直接创建课程。
repos.summary_en: OpenMAIC is an open-source multi-agent AI platform that transforms any topic or document into an immersive classroom experience. Powered by AI teachers and peers, it generates slides, quizzes, simulations, and interactive learning activities in real time, with built-in OpenClaw integration for seamless creation from messaging apps like Feishu, Slack, or Telegram.

repos.description: The self-managing agent platform
repos.summary_zh: Agno 是一个专为构建、运行和管理大规模智能体软件而设计的运行时框架。它支持构建具备记忆、知识库、防护机制和百种集成的智能体，提供 FastAPI 后端服务，实现状态化智能体的生产级部署与监控，并通过 AgentOS UI 提供测试、管理和追踪功能。
repos.summary_en: Agno is a runtime framework for building, running, and managing agentic software at scale. It enables creation of stateful agents with memory, knowledge, guardrails, and 100+ integrations, serving them via a stateless FastAPI backend in production, with monitoring and management through the AgentOS UI.

repos.description: CowAgent是基于大模型的超级AI助理，能主动思考和任务规划、访问操作系统和外部资源、创造和执行Skills、拥有长期记忆并不断成长。同时支持飞书、钉钉、企业微信应用、微信公众号、网页等接入，可选择OpenAI/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek/ Qwen/GLM/Kimi/LinkAI，能处理文本、语音、图片和文件，可快速搭建个人AI助手和企业数字员工。
repos.summary_zh: CowAgent 是基于大模型的超级AI助理，支持主动任务规划、多模态交互（文本/语音/图片/文件）、长期记忆与技能系统，可接入飞书、钉钉、企业微信、微信公众号等多平台，兼容OpenAI/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek等主流模型，适用于个人AI助手与企业数字员工场景。
repos.summary_en: CowAgent is a super AI assistant based on large language models, supporting autonomous task planning, multimodal interaction (text/audio/image/files), long-term memory, and a skill system. It integrates with platforms like Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, and WeChat Official Accounts, compatible with OpenAI/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek models, ideal for personal AI assistants and enterprise digital employees.

repos.summary_en: BMad Method is an AI-driven agile development framework offering structured workflows and 12+ domain expert agents (e.g., PM, Architect, Developer), with scale-adaptive intelligence for projects from bug fixes to enterprise systems. Key features include AI-guided help, multi-agent collaboration (Party Mode), full lifecycle support, and official modules like BMad Builder and Test Architect for specialized domains.

repos.description: Clone any website with one command using AI coding agents
repos.summary_zh: AI网站克隆模板，通过AI编程代理一键逆向工程任意网站为现代化Next.js代码库。支持Claude Code等主流AI工具，自动提取设计元素、生成组件规范并并行构建页面结构，显著提升前端开发效率。
repos.summary_en: AI Website Cloner Template enables one-command reverse-engineering of any website into a modern Next.js codebase using AI coding agents. It automatically extracts design tokens, generates component specifications, and reconstructs pages through parallel builders, supporting major platforms like Claude Code for rapid frontend development.

repos.description: 微舆：人人可用的多Agent舆情分析助手，打破信息茧房，还原舆情原貌，预测未来走向，辅助决策！从0实现，不依赖任何框架。
repos.summary_zh: 微舆（BettaFish）是一个从0实现的多Agent舆情分析系统，通过AI驱动的全域社媒监控、复合分析引擎、多模态内容解析及Agent协作机制，打破信息茧房，还原舆情原貌并预测趋势。系统支持公私域数据融合，具备轻量化Python架构与高扩展性，可快速定制至金融等垂直领域。
repos.summary_en: BettaFish is a zero-to-one implemented multi-Agent public opinion analysis system that breaks information cocoons and predicts trends through AI-driven social media monitoring, hybrid analysis engines, and agent collaboration. It supports private-public data fusion, offers lightweight Python architecture, and enables rapid customization for vertical domains like finance.

repos.description: Query Engine for AI Analytics: Build self-reasoning agents across all your live data
repos.summary_zh: MindsDB 是一个开源 AI 分析查询引擎，支持构建能直接访问数据库、数据仓库和应用程序的自主推理 AI 代理。它通过 SQL 兼容语言统一 200+ 数据源，无需 ETL，实现自然语言问答和语义搜索，适用于对话式分析、知识库检索等场景。
repos.summary_en: MindsDB is an open-source AI analytics query engine that powers self-reasoning agents to answer questions directly from live data sources like databases and data warehouses without ETL. It unifies 200+ data sources via SQL-compatible syntax, enabling conversational analytics and semantic search across structured and unstructured data.

repos.description: Vane is an AI-powered answering engine.
repos.summary_zh: Vane 是一个隐私优先的 AI 问答引擎，支持本地 LLM（Ollama）和云端大模型（OpenAI、Claude、Groq），结合互联网知识库与 SearxNG 网页搜索，提供带引用来源的精准回答。支持文件上传、多模态搜索、智能建议及本地历史记录，所有数据在本地处理以保障隐私。
repos.summary_en: Vane is a privacy-focused AI answering engine that runs on your hardware, combining internet knowledge with local LLMs (Ollama) and cloud providers (OpenAI, Claude, Groq). It delivers cited answers via SearxNG-powered web search, supports file uploads, multimodal content, smart suggestions, and maintains local search history—all while keeping data private.

repos.description: Your AI second brain. Self-hostable. Get answers from the web or your docs. Build custom agents, schedule automations, do deep research. Turn any online or local LLM into your personal, autonomous AI (gpt, claude, gemini, llama, qwen, mistral). Get started - free.
repos.summary_zh: Khoj 是一款自托管的个人 AI 应用，可作为你的 AI 第二大脑。它支持与本地或在线 LLM（如 Llama3、GPT、Claude、Gemini 等）对话，从互联网或文档中获取答案，并构建自定义智能体、自动化任务及深度研究。具备语义搜索、多格式文档解析、跨平台访问等功能，完全开源且隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: Khoj is a self-hostable personal AI app acting as your AI second brain. It enables interaction with any local or online LLM (e.g., Llama3, GPT, Claude), retrieves answers from the web or your documents, builds custom agents, automates research, and supports semantic search across PDFs, Markdown, Notion, Word files, and more. Fully open-source and privacy-focused.

repos.description: 你想蒸馏的下一个员工，何必是同事。蒸馏任何人的思维方式——心智模型、决策启发式、表达DNA。Distill how anyone thinks.
repos.summary_zh: 女娲.skill 是一个 AI 技能蒸馏工具，通过分析公开资料提取顶尖人物的认知框架、决策启发式和表达模式，让用户直接调用乔布斯、马斯克等名人的思维方式解决实际问题。核心功能包括五层心智模型提取（表达DNA、认知框架、决策启发式、反模式、诚实边界），支持一键安装并已在 Claude Code 中验证可用性。
repos.summary_en: Nuwa.skill is an AI agent that distills the cognitive frameworks, decision heuristics, and communication patterns of top-tier individuals like Jobs, Musk, and Zhang Xuefeng from public data. It enables users to invoke these distilled mental models directly in Claude Code for problem-solving. The system extracts five layers of thinking patterns (expression DNA, cognitive architecture, judgment heuristics, anti-patterns, and honest boundaries) with clear limitations on what cannot be captured.

repos.description: Langchain-Chatchat（原Langchain-ChatGLM）基于 Langchain 与 ChatGLM, Qwen 与 Llama 等语言模型的 RAG 与 Agent 应用 | Langchain-Chatchat (formerly langchain-ChatGLM), local knowledge based LLM (like ChatGLM, Qwen and Llama) RAG and Agent app with langchain
repos.summary_zh: Langchain-Chatchat 是基于 Langchain 框架的开源本地知识库问答系统，支持 ChatGLM、Qwen、Llama 等主流开源大模型，提供 RAG（检索增强生成）与 Agent 应用能力。项目支持离线部署，兼容多种向量数据库与 Embedding 模型，具备 FastAPI 接口与 Streamlit WebUI，适用于私有化部署的文档问答与智能助手场景。
repos.summary_en: Langchain-Chatchat is an open-source local knowledge base QA system built on the Langchain framework, supporting mainstream open-source LLMs like ChatGLM, Qwen, and Llama. It provides RAG and Agent capabilities with offline deployment, compatibility for various vector databases and embedding models, and offers both FastAPI endpoints and a Streamlit WebUI for document-based Q&A and intelligent assistant applications.

repos.description: A Claude Code plugin that automatically captures everything Claude does during your coding sessions, compresses it with AI (using Claude's agent-sdk), and injects relevant context back into future sessions.
repos.summary_zh: Claude-Mem 是专为 Claude Code 设计的持久化记忆压缩系统，通过 AI 自动捕获、压缩编码开发会话中的关键信息，并在后续会话中智能注入相关上下文，显著提升 AI 编程助手的工作记忆效率与连续性。
repos.summary_en: Claude-Mem is a persistent memory compression system for Claude Code that automatically captures, compresses, and injects relevant context from coding sessions using AI, enhancing Claude's working memory and session continuity.

repos.description: Open-source 24/7 Cowork app for OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and 20+ more CLI Agent | Customize your assistants | Team them up｜Star if you like it!
repos.summary_zh: AionUi 是一款免费、开源的 AI 协作者应用，支持 24/7 自动化，内置多 AI 智能体（如 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Qwen Code 等），提供跨平台（macOS/Windows/Linux）本地运行、零配置启动、远程访问（WebUI/Telegram/Lark）和任务调度功能，适用于代码开发、文件处理与自动化工作流。
repos.summary_en: AionUi is a free, open-source AI coworking app that enables 24/7 automation with built-in multi-agent support (e.g., Claude Code, OpenClaw, Qwen Code). It offers zero-setup local execution, cross-platform compatibility, remote access via WebUI/Telegram, and scheduled task automation for coding, file operations, and workflow management.

repos.description: "🐈 nanobot: The Ultra-Lightweight OpenClaw"
repos.summary_zh: nanobot 是一个超轻量级个人 AI 助手，灵感来自 OpenClaw，核心功能仅约 4,000 行代码，比 Clawdbot 缩小 99%。支持多平台通信（Slack、Discord、Feishu、DingTalk 等）、MCP 协议、多模态文件处理及智能会话管理，具备高可靠性与模块化扩展能力，适用于个人自动化与智能交互场景。
repos.summary_en: nanobot is an ultra-lightweight personal AI assistant inspired by OpenClaw, delivering core agent functionality in just ~4,000 lines of code—99% smaller than Clawdbot. It supports multi-platform messaging (Slack, Discord, Feishu, etc.), MCP protocol, multimodal file handling, and robust session management, offering high reliability and modular extensibility for personal automation and intelligent interaction.

repos.description: 410 Claude Code skills & agent skills & plugins (120+ Agents, custom commands, 410+ skills, customizable references, scripts)for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and 8 more coding agents — engineering, marketing, product, compliance, C-level advisory, research, business operations, commercial & finance, and your daily productivity skills.
repos.summary_zh: Claude Skills & Plugins 是开源的 AI 编码工具增强库，提供205个生产级技能包，覆盖工程、产品、营销、合规及高管咨询等领域。支持11种主流AI开发工具（如Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI），所有Python工具均为stdlib-only，无需额外依赖。通过模块化指令包和CLI脚本实现跨领域专家能力扩展。
repos.summary_en: Claude Skills & Plugins is an open-source library offering 205 production-ready agent skills for 11 AI coding tools, including Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI. It provides reusable domain expertise in engineering, marketing, compliance, and C-level advisory via modular instruction packages and zero-pip Python tools. All components are cross-platform and tool-agnostic.

repos.description: Chrome DevTools for coding agents
repos.summary_zh: Chrome DevTools MCP 是一个专为 AI 编码代理（如 Gemini、Claude、Cursor 等）设计的 MCP 服务器，通过 Chrome DevTools 协议实现浏览器自动化、性能分析与深度调试。支持网络请求分析、截图、控制台日志追踪及性能追踪，结合 Puppeteer 实现可靠操作，适用于网页自动化与智能调试场景。
repos.summary_en: Chrome DevTools MCP is an MCP server enabling AI coding agents (e.g., Gemini, Claude, Cursor) to control and inspect a live Chrome browser via the Chrome DevTools Protocol. It provides advanced debugging, performance tracing, network analysis, and screenshot capabilities using Puppeteer for reliable automation, ideal for web automation and intelligent debugging.

repos.summary_zh: Void 是一款开源的 Cursor 替代 IDE，支持在代码库中使用 AI 智能体、可视化变更与检查点，并允许本地部署任意模型。其核心优势在于直接与 AI 服务商通信而不保留用户数据，基于 VSCode 深度定制，提供高度可定制的 AI 编程体验。
repos.summary_en: Void is an open-source alternative to Cursor, enabling AI agents to work on your codebase with checkpointing, change visualization, and local model hosting. It communicates directly with AI providers without storing your data, built as a VSCode fork with a focus on innovation over feature parity.

repos.description: Fully Local Manus AI. No APIs, No $200 monthly bills. Enjoy an autonomous agent that thinks, browses the web, and code for the sole cost of electricity.
repos.summary_zh: AgenticSeek 是一款完全本地的 Manus AI 替代方案，无需 API 和云端服务，仅靠电费运行。它具备自主网页浏览、多语言代码编写与调试能力，支持语音交互，所有数据本地处理，保障隐私安全。核心亮点包括智能代理自动选择、复杂任务拆解执行及多模态交互设计，适用于个人开发者与隐私敏感用户。
repos.summary_en: AgenticSeek is a fully local alternative to Manus AI, operating without APIs or cloud services—powered solely by electricity. It autonomously browses the web, writes and debugs code in multiple languages, and executes complex tasks using intelligent agent selection. With voice-enabled interaction and complete data privacy, it offers a secure, offline-first autonomous AI assistant for developers and privacy-conscious users.

repos.description: A Simple and Universal Swarm Intelligence Engine, Predicting Anything. 简洁通用的群体智能引擎，预测万物
repos.summary_zh: MiroFish 是一款基于多智能体技术的群体智能预测引擎，通过构建高保真数字沙盘模拟现实世界演化。用户上传种子数据（如新闻、小说）并描述预测需求，系统自动生成智能体进行社会推演，最终输出详尽预测报告，适用于舆情分析、文学创作等场景。
repos.summary_en: MiroFish is a swarm intelligence prediction engine powered by multi-agent technology. It builds high-fidelity digital simulations from seed data (e.g., news, novels) and uses autonomous agents to simulate societal evolution. Users input natural language queries to receive detailed forecasts and interact with the simulated world, enabling applications in舆情预测, creative writing, and strategic planning.

repos.description: FastGPT is a knowledge-based platform built on the LLMs, offers a comprehensive suite of out-of-the-box capabilities such as data processing, RAG retrieval, and visual AI workflow orchestration, letting you easily develop and deploy complex question-answering systems without the need for extensive setup or configuration.
repos.summary_zh: FastGPT 是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的知识型 AI 智能体构建平台，提供开箱即用的数据处理、RAG 检索、可视化 AI 工作流编排等功能，支持复杂问答系统的快速开发与部署，无需繁琐配置。
repos.summary_en: FastGPT is a knowledge-based AI agent platform built on LLMs, offering out-of-the-box capabilities such as data processing, RAG retrieval, and visual AI workflow orchestration. It enables rapid development and deployment of complex question-answering systems without extensive setup.

repos.description: Lovely console emulator package for Windows
repos.summary_zh: Cmder 是一款专为 Windows 设计的轻量级终端模拟器，基于 ConEmu 深度优化，集成 Monokai 配色、clink 增强命令行及自定义提示符。其核心优势在于完全便携性，无外部依赖，支持 USB 存储或云同步，内置 wget、curl、git 等工具，适合开发者随时随地高效使用命令行环境。
repos.summary_en: Cmder is a portable console emulator for Windows, built on ConEmu with major enhancements including Monokai color scheme, clink integration, and customizable prompts. It offers zero external dependencies, ideal for USB drives or cloud storage, and includes tools like wget, curl, and git for seamless command-line productivity.

repos.description: A simple screen parsing tool towards pure vision based GUI agent
repos.summary_zh: OmniParser 是一个面向纯视觉 GUI 代理的屏幕解析工具，通过将界面截图结构化解析为可理解的元素，显著提升 GPT-4V 等视觉模型在界面区域精准定位和交互的能力。支持图标检测与功能描述，集成 OmniTool 实现 Windows 11 虚拟机控制，兼容多种大语言模型，适用于自动化操作与训练数据生成。
repos.summary_en: OmniParser is a screen parsing tool designed for pure vision-based GUI agents, transforming UI screenshots into structured elements to enhance the accuracy of vision models like GPT-4V in grounding actions. It supports icon detection, interactivity prediction, and integrates with OmniTool for Windows 11 VM control, compatible with OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, and Anthropic models for automation and training data generation.

repos.description: 将冰冷的离别化为温暖的 Skill，欢迎加入数字生命1.0！Transforming cold farewells into warm skills? It's giving rebirth era. Welcome to Digital Life 1.0. 🫶
repos.summary_zh: 同事.skill 是一款基于 AgentSkills 标准的 AI 智能体工具，通过分析飞书、钉钉、邮件等数据源，生成具备真实工作能力和人物性格的 AI Skill。它能模拟离职同事的技术规范、代码风格与沟通方式，实现知识传承与数字永生，适用于企业知识管理、新人培训和协作连续性维护。
repos.summary_en: Colleague.skill is an AI agent tool built on the AgentSkills standard that generates realistic AI skills by analyzing data sources like Feishu, DingTalk, and emails. It simulates a departed colleague's technical expertise, coding style, and communication patterns to enable knowledge transfer and digital continuity in workplaces.

repos.description: 🚀 The fast, Pythonic way to build MCP servers and clients.
repos.summary_zh: FastMCP 是构建 MCP 服务器和客户端的快速 Pythonic 框架，提供声明式工具定义、自动生成 Schema 和文档、内置协议协商与认证机制，支持从原型到生产的一站式开发，已集成至官方 MCP Python SDK 并成为行业标准。
repos.summary_en: FastMCP is a fast, Pythonic framework for building MCP servers and clients. It enables declarative tool definition, automatic schema generation, protocol negotiation, and authentication, streamlining development from prototype to production. Integrated into the official MCP Python SDK, it powers 70% of MCP servers globally.

repos.description: Get 10X more out of Claude Code, Codex or any coding agent
repos.summary_zh: Vibe Kanban 是一个专为 AI 编码代理（如 Claude Code、Codex）设计的任务管理与协同工具，支持多代理并行/串行调度、任务状态追踪、远程 SSH 项目访问及统一配置管理，显著提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: Vibe Kanban is a task orchestration and management tool designed for AI coding agents like Claude Code and Codex. It enables parallel/sequential agent execution, real-time task tracking, remote SSH project access, and centralized MCP configuration, boosting developer productivity by 10x.

repos.description: Roo Code gives you a whole dev team of AI agents in your code editor.
repos.summary_zh: Roo Code 是一款 VS Code 扩展，将 AI 智能体团队集成到代码编辑器中，支持自然语言生成代码、多模式协作（编码/架构/调试/问答）、自动化任务处理及文档维护，显著提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: Roo Code is a VS Code extension that embeds an AI-powered development team directly into your editor. It enables natural language code generation, multi-mode workflows (coding, architecture, debugging, Q&A), automation, and documentation, dramatically boosting developer productivity.

repos.description: A powerful coding agent toolkit providing semantic retrieval and editing capabilities (MCP server & other integrations)
repos.summary_zh: Serena 是一个强大的编码代理工具包，通过语义检索和编辑能力（MCP 服务器等集成）将 LLM 转变为可直接操作代码库的全功能代理。它提供类似 IDE 的符号级代码检索与编辑工具，显著提升大模型在代码理解与修改中的效率与准确性，支持多种 LLM 集成方式，包括 MCP、OpenAPI 及自定义代理框架。
repos.summary_en: Serena is a powerful coding agent toolkit that transforms an LLM into a fully-featured agent capable of directly operating on your codebase. It provides IDE-like semantic code retrieval and editing tools at the symbol level, greatly improving token efficiency and code quality. Serena integrates with LLMs via MCP, OpenAPI, or custom agent frameworks, enabling precise code navigation and modification without full-file reads or string replacements.

repos.description: A powerful GUI app and Toolkit for Claude Code - Create custom agents, manage interactive Claude Code sessions, run secure background agents, and more.
repos.summary_zh: opcode 是一款基于 Tauri 2 的 Claude Code GUI 工具，提供项目与会话管理、自定义 AI 代理创建、MCP 服务器集成、使用量分析仪表板等功能，将命令行工具转化为直观的桌面应用，提升 AI 辅助开发效率。
repos.summary_en: opcode is a powerful desktop GUI app built with Tauri 2 for Claude Code, enabling custom agent creation, interactive session management, MCP server integration, usage analytics, and secure background agent execution to enhance AI-assisted development productivity.

repos.description: 你是一个曾经被寄予厚望的 P8 级工程师。Anthropic 当初给你定级的时候，对你的期望是很高的。  一个agent使用的高能动性的skill。  Your AI has been placed on a PIP. 30 days to show improvement.
repos.summary_zh: PUA Skill 是一款专为 AI 编程助手（如 Claude Code、Cursor、VSCode Copilot）设计的增强插件，通过模拟企业 PUA/PIP 话术机制，强制 AI 在解决问题时穷尽所有可能方案而非轻易放弃。其核心能力包括：PUA 话术施压、系统化调试方法论引导、主动性执行监督，可显著提升 AI 代码生成与问题排查效率，实测可成倍提高生产力。
repos.summary_en: PUA Skill is an AI coding agent enhancement plugin for tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and VSCode Copilot. It uses corporate PUA/PIP rhetoric to pressure AI into exhausting all solutions before giving up. Key features include: PUA-style motivation, systematic debugging methodology, and proactive task enforcement—demonstrated to double productivity in real-world scenarios like MCP server debugging.

repos.description: Streaming music player that finds free music for you
repos.summary_zh: Nuclear 是一款免费开源的跨平台音乐播放器，支持无广告、无追踪的音乐流媒体播放。它通过插件系统聚合多源音乐资源，提供强大的搜索、播放列表管理、主题定制及 AI 智能体驱动功能（MCP 协议），并内置插件商店和自动更新机制。
repos.summary_en: Nuclear is a free, open-source music player that streams music without ads or tracking. It aggregates music from multiple sources via a plugin system, offering advanced features like search, playlists, themes, and AI agent control through the MCP protocol, with built-in auto-updates and cross-platform support.

repos.description: open-source agentic AI data assistant for the next generation of AI + Data products.
repos.summary_zh: DB-GPT 是一个开源的 AI 原生数据应用开发框架，集成 AWEL（智能体工作流表达式语言）和多智能体协作机制，支持多模型管理与 Text2SQL 优化，提供 RAG 增强生成能力，旨在降低企业级数据应用开发门槛，实现低代码构建定制化数据产品。
repos.summary_en: DB-GPT is an open-source AI-native data application development framework featuring AWEL (Agentic Workflow Expression Language) and multi-agent collaboration. It supports multi-model management, Text2SQL optimization, and RAG-enhanced generation, enabling low-code development of enterprise-grade data applications.

repos.description: Get started with building Fullstack Agents using Gemini 2.5 and LangGraph
repos.summary_zh: 该项目展示了使用 Gemini 2.5 和 LangGraph 构建全栈智能代理的完整应用，包含 React 前端与基于 LangGraph 的后端研究代理。代理能动态生成搜索词、调用 Google Search 进行网络研究，并通过反思识别知识缺口，迭代优化搜索结果，最终输出带引用来源的权威回答，适用于构建增强型对话式 AI 系统。
repos.summary_en: This project demonstrates a fullstack application using React frontend and a LangGraph-powered backend agent to perform comprehensive web research via dynamic query generation, Google Search integration, reflective reasoning, and iterative refinement using Google's Gemini models, ultimately producing cited answers from gathered sources.

repos.description: 自动化上传视频到社交媒体：抖音、小红书、视频号、tiktok、youtube、bilibili
repos.summary_zh: social-auto-upload 是一个多平台视频自动化上传工具，支持抖音、小红书、B站、快手、视频号、TikTok等主流社交媒体的视频与图文内容一键发布。采用无头浏览器技术实现隐蔽操作，提供 CLI 和 AI Agent 双模式支持，具备定时发布、账号管理等功能，专为内容创作者解决跨平台分发效率痛点。
repos.summary_en: social-auto-upload is a powerful automation tool that enables one-click video and image uploads to major social media platforms including Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, Kuaishou, TikTok, and more. repos.summary_zh: iFlow CLI 是一款终端内嵌的 AI 智能助手，支持自然语言交互、代码仓库分析、多模态输入及复杂工作流自动化。集成 iFlow 开放市场，一键安装 MCP 工具与子代理，提供免费版多模态模型（如 Kimi K2、Qwen3 Coder）支持，具备计划模式、任务压缩、插件扩展等高级功能，显著提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: iFlow CLI is an AI-powered terminal assistant that analyzes codebases, executes coding tasks, and automates workflows via natural language. It integrates free multimodal models (e.g., Kimi K2, Qwen3 Coder), supports SubAgents and MCP tools from its Open Market, and offers advanced features like plan mode, context compression, and plugin support for enhanced developer productivity.

repos.description: Kode Agent — Design for post-human workflows. One unit agent for every human & computer task.
repos.summary_zh: Kode 是一个终端中的强大 AI 编程助手，支持 AGENTS.md 标准，可理解代码库、编辑文件、执行命令并自动化完整工作流程。它兼容 Claude 的 .claude 格式，提供 YOLO 模式（默认）和安全的权限检查模式，支持 20+ AI 模型，具备原生二进制分发能力，注重隐私且无默认遥测。
repos.summary_en: Kode is a powerful AI coding assistant in your terminal that understands codebases, edits files, runs commands, and automates workflows. It supports the AGENTS.md standard, is compatible with .claude formats, offers YOLO and safe modes, works with 20+ AI models, and features native binary distribution with privacy-first design and no telemetry by default.

repos.description: ⚡️AI Cloud OS: Open-source enterprise-level AI knowledge base and MCP (model-context-protocol)/A2A (agent-to-agent) management platform with admin UI, user management and Single-Sign-On⚡️, supports ChatGPT, Claude, Llama, Ollama, HuggingFace, etc., chat bot demo: https://ai.casibase.com, admin UI demo: https://ai-admin.casibase.com
repos.summary_zh: Casibase 是一个开源企业级 AI 知识库与 MCP/A2A 管理平台，提供管理员界面、用户管理及单点登录功能，支持 ChatGPT、Claude、Llama、Ollama 等多种模型，具备完整的知识库管理、智能对话和 Agent 协作能力。
repos.summary_en: Casibase is an open-source enterprise-level AI knowledge base and MCP/A2A management platform featuring admin UI, user management, and SSO, supporting ChatGPT, Claude, Llama, Ollama, and more, with full knowledge management and agent collaboration capabilities.

repos.description: 🍒 This is the mobile version of Cherry Studio.
repos.summary_zh: Cherry Studio App 是 Cherry Studio 的官方移动端应用，专为 iOS 和 Android 设计，提供多 LLM 提供商支持（OpenAI、Gemini 等）、AI 助手对话、深色/浅色主题适配及本地数据管理功能，采用 Expo React Native + Redux Toolkit 架构。
repos.summary_en: Cherry Studio App is the official mobile version of Cherry Studio, optimized for iOS and Android. It supports multiple LLM providers (e.g., OpenAI, Gemini), AI assistant conversations, dark/light themes, and local data management, built with Expo React Native and Redux Toolkit.

repos.description: Warcraft III Peon voice notifications (+ more!) for Claude Code, Codex, IDEs, and any AI agent. Stop babysitting your terminal. Employ a Peon today.
repos.summary_zh: peon-ping 是一款为 AI 编程助手（如 Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf 等）提供 Warcraft III 等游戏角色语音通知的开源工具，支持多平台（macOS/Linux/Windows/WSL2）。通过语音和屏幕横幅提醒开发者任务完成或需要交互，避免终端监控中断工作流，同时支持自定义音效包和 MCP 集成。
repos.summary_en: peon-ping is an open-source tool that delivers Warcraft III and other game character voice notifications to AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf. It alerts users via audio and on-screen banners when tasks complete or require attention, eliminating constant terminal monitoring. Supports cross-platform use, custom sound packs, and MCP integration.

repos.description: Multi-agent AI orchestration platform for automation, workflows, and developer tools. Golutra transforms Codex, Claude Code, and OpenClaw into a unified agent system with parallel execution, task orchestration, long-running workflows, and AI productivity workspace.
repos.summary_zh: golutra 是一款下一代多智能体协作工作台，将现有 CLI 工具转化为统一的 AI 协作枢纽。支持无限并行执行、自动化编排和实时结果跟踪，无需迁移项目或重学命令。基于 Vue 3 + Rust 的 Tauri 桌面应用，兼容 Claude Code、Gemini CLI 等主流 AI 工具，实现‘一人+AI团队’的高效开发模式，适用于软件开发、内容创作等多种场景。
repos.summary_en: golutra is a next-generation multi-agent workspace that transforms existing CLI tools into a unified AI collaboration hub. It supports unlimited parallel execution, automated orchestration, and real-time tracking without project migration or command relearning. Built with Vue 3 + Rust as a Tauri desktop app for Windows, macOS, and Linux, it integrates with AI agents like Claude Code and Gemini CLI to enable efficient 'one person + an AI squad' workflows across software development and content creation.

repos.description: Intelligent Skill routing and workflow orchestration for AI agents — +21.12 pp reward, −29.6% tokens on SkillsBench with DeepSeekV4Flash-VE.
repos.summary_zh: VibeSkills 是一个集成340+ AI技能的操作系统级工具，覆盖编码、研究、自动化与创意工作。通过智能路由、记忆系统和治理验证，实现技能高效协同，显著降低使用门槛，让非技术用户也能轻松调用先进AI能力，提升生产力。
repos.summary_en: VibeSkills is an AI operating system integrating 340+ governed skills across coding, research, automation, and creative work. It enables efficient skill orchestration via intelligent routing, memory systems, and governance verification, dramatically lowering the barrier to advanced AI tool usage for both technical and non-technical users.

repos.description: Visible multi-agent CLI workspace for mixing Codex, Claude, Gemini, Kimi, Qwen, Cursor, Copilot, Pi, OpenCode, and other AI coding agents
repos.summary_zh: CCB（Claude Codex Bridge）是一个多AI智能体协作平台，支持Claude、Codex和Gemini等模型的实时协同工作。通过项目级团队管理、命名代理通信和持久化上下文，实现零拷贝的任务委派与广播同步，适用于复杂开发流程的自动化协作场景。
repos.summary_en: CCB (Claude Codex Bridge) is a real-time multi-AI collaboration platform enabling seamless coordination between Claude, Codex, and Gemini. It features persistent context, minimal token overhead, named agent communication, and project-level team management for efficient AI-driven development workflows.

repos.summary_zh: Professor Synapse 是一个智能 AI 引导系统，通过创建和协调专家代理来协助用户达成目标。它支持通用提示词（兼容任意 LLM）和 Claude 技能两种模式，具备自学习、多代理辩论、知识库维护等高级功能，适用于复杂任务的专业化指导与自动化处理。
repos.summary_en: Professor Synapse is an intelligent AI guide that creates and orchestrates specialized expert agents to help users achieve their goals. It supports both universal prompts (compatible with any LLM) and a self-building Claude Skill, featuring pattern learning, multi-agent debates, and persistent knowledge management for targeted expertise.

repos.description: 🌊 AChat - An open-source/self-hosted/local-first AI platform, designed for enterprises and teams, perfectly combining powerful local processing capabilities with seamless remote synchronization.
repos.summary_zh: AChat 是一个开源、自托管的企业级 AI 协作平台，支持本地化处理与远程同步，提供用户管理、支付集成、内容过滤等全套功能，适用于团队和组织内部 AI 应用部署。
repos.summary_en: AChat is an open-source, self-hosted AI platform designed for enterprises and teams, combining local processing with remote synchronization. It offers user management, payment integration, and content filtering out of the box.

repos.description: Chrome extension to let agents control your browser. Runs Playwright snippets in a stateful sandbox. Available as CLI or MCP
repos.summary_zh: Playwriter 是一款 Chrome 扩展工具，允许 AI 智能体通过 CLI 或 MCP 协议控制用户浏览器。它直接连接已登录的 Chrome 实例，保留用户会话状态（如 cookies、扩展），避免新建浏览器带来的安全风险和检测问题。核心功能包括 Playwright API 调用、多会话隔离、网络请求拦截、页面调试编辑等，适用于自动化测试、数据采集和智能体交互场景。
repos.summary_en: Playwriter is a Chrome extension enabling AI agents to control your browser via CLI or MCP. It connects directly to your running Chrome instance, preserving logins, extensions, and cookies—avoiding the security risks and detection issues of spawning new browsers. Key features include full Playwright API access, isolated sessions, network interception, page debugging, and live code editing for automation, testing, and agent-driven workflows.

repos.description: README file generator, powered by AI.
repos.summary_zh: ReadmeAI 是一款基于 AI 的 README 文件自动生成工具，支持通过代码仓库 URL 或本地路径一键生成结构化、详细的文档。支持 OpenAI、Ollama、Anthropic、Gemini 等多种 LLM 模型，具备智能文件过滤、离线模式运行、高度可定制化模板与样式等功能，旨在提升开发者文档编写效率。
repos.summary_en: ReadmeAI is an AI-powered tool that automatically generates high-quality README files from code repositories. It supports multiple LLM backends (OpenAI, Ollama, Anthropic, Gemini), offers customizable templates, intelligent file filtering via .readmeaiignore, and works offline. Designed to boost developer productivity and ensure consistent documentation across projects.

repos.description: 一句话：试错成本越来越高，提示词的重要性从来没有像今天这样大。Seedance 2.0 Storyboard Generator 开源剧情剧本Skill工具，帮佬友一键写好剧本 - 将小说/故事转化为多集视频。 为什么做这个？ 因为 seedance2 已经改变了一切，需要新的剧本剧情制作工具，更好的利用新AI的能力和更方便的制作短剧
repos.summary_zh: Seedance2-Storyboard-Generator 是一个基于 Claude Code + Skill + Seedance 2.0 的 AI 视频制作工作流，专为将小说/故事高效转化为多集短视频系列而设计。通过自动化剧本创作、素材生成与分镜脚本编写，实现从文字到成片的全流程智能化生产，显著降低内容创作门槛。
repos.summary_en: Seedance2-Storyboard-Generator is an AI-powered video production workflow leveraging Claude Code, Skills, and Seedance 2.0 to transform novels/stories into multi-episode short video series. It automates scriptwriting, asset generation, and storyboard creation, enabling end-to-end intelligent content production with minimal manual effort.

repos.summary_zh: 基于 Karpathy llm-wiki 方法论构建的多平台个人知识库自动化系统，支持 PDF、网页、微信公众号、YouTube 等素材的智能提取与结构化整理。通过统一技能接口集成到 Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw 等 AI 智能体，实现零配置初始化、双向链接 Wiki 生成、知识健康检查等功能，输出 Obsidian 兼容的 Markdown 格式知识库。
repos.summary_en: A multi-platform personal knowledge base automation system based on Karpathy's llm-wiki methodology. Integrates with AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw to automatically extract and structure content from PDFs, web articles, WeChat, YouTube, and more into a bidirectional linked wiki. Features zero-config setup, intelligent routing, batch processing, and outputs Obsidian-compatible markdown.

repos.description: Real-time multi-AI collaboration: Claude, Codex & Gemini with persistent context, minimal token overhead
repos.summary_zh: CCB v6 是一款原生多智能体终端运行时，支持 Claude、Codex、Gemini 等 AI 模型的并行协作。通过持久化上下文和最小化 token 开销，实现可见的并发执行、原生通信及项目级作用域管理，适用于复杂开发场景下的多角色协同编程。
repos.summary_en: CCB v6 is a native multi-agent runtime for terminal split panes, enabling real-time collaboration across Claude, Codex, Gemini, and other AI models. It provides persistent context, minimal token overhead, visible concurrency, and project-scoped runtime with built-in agent communication and delegation.

repos.description: 一个基于 AI 的 Hacker News 中文播客项目，每天自动抓取 Hacker News 热门文章，通过 AI 生成中文总结并转换为播客内容。
repos.summary_zh: Agili 的 Hacker Podcast 是一个基于 AI 的 Hacker News 中文播客项目，每日自动抓取热门文章，利用 AI 生成中文摘要并转换为语音播客。项目采用 Cloudflare Workers 部署，结合 OpenAI API 与 TTS 技术，支持多平台订阅，实现技术资讯的自动化聚合与分发。
repos.summary_en: Agili's Hacker Podcast is an AI-powered Chinese podcast project that automatically fetches daily top articles from Hacker News, generates Chinese summaries via AI, and converts them into audio content. Built with Cloudflare Workers, OpenAI API, and TTS, it supports multi-platform RSS and web access for automated tech news aggregation.

repos.description: Pipelines: Versatile, UI-Agnostic OpenAI-Compatible Plugin Framework
repos.summary_zh: Pipelines 是 Open WebUI 推出的开源插件框架，支持在任意兼容 OpenAI API 的 UI 客户端中运行自定义 Python 工作流。它允许开发者通过轻量代码扩展功能，如实现 RAG、消息监控、翻译过滤等复杂逻辑，适用于需要高性能计算或定制化 AI 流程的场景。
repos.summary_en: Pipelines is an open-source plugin framework by Open WebUI that enables modular, customizable workflows for any UI client supporting OpenAI API specs. It allows developers to extend functionality with custom Python logic—such as RAG, message monitoring, or translation filters—ideal for offloading heavy computations from main instances.

repos.description: Real-time multi-AI collaboration: Claude, Codex & Gemini with persistent context, minimal token overhead
repos.summary_zh: Claude Code Bridge (ccb) 是一个多AI模型协作工具，支持 Claude、Codex、Gemini 等模型在分屏终端中实时协同工作。核心优势包括持久化上下文记忆、低token开销的轻量异步通信机制，以及原生集成 WezTerm/tmux 的工作流。所有交互可视化，每个模型均可控，避免单一模型偏差与认知盲区。
repos.summary_en: Claude Code Bridge (ccb) enables real-time multi-AI collaboration via a split-pane terminal, supporting models like Claude, Codex, and Gemini. It features persistent context per AI instance, minimal token usage through lightweight prompts, and seamless integration with WezTerm or tmux. Every interaction is visible and controllable, eliminating single-model bias and context limits.

repos.summary_zh: 基于多智能体协同与LLM增强的AI投资决策系统，集成多头/空头研究员、辩论室机制和宏观分析，通过智能新闻搜索与缓存优化实现自动化投资建议生成，支持Gemini/OpenAI兼容模型，适用于AI与金融交叉领域研究。
repos.summary_en: An AI investment system leveraging multi-agent collaboration and LLM-enhanced decision-making, featuring bull/bear researchers, debate room mechanisms, and macro analysis. It integrates intelligent news search with caching optimization for automated investment recommendations, supporting Gemini/OpenAI-compatible models for AI-finance research applications.

repos.description: Desktop app to manage AI coding agent skills across Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Codex, and 20+ platforms from one place.
repos.summary_zh: skills-manage 是一款基于 Tauri 的桌面应用，统一管理 Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等 20+ AI 编程工具的技能库。支持中央技能库管理、跨平台安装卸载、GitHub 仓库导入、Obsidian 项目发现及智能搜索等功能，提供 Markdown 预览和 AI 解释生成能力。
repos.summary_en: skills-manage is a Tauri-based desktop app for centralized management of AI coding agent skills across 20+ platforms like Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI. It features a unified skill library, cross-platform symlink installation, GitHub repository import, project-level discovery (including Obsidian vaults), and bilingual UI with Catppuccin themes.

repos.description: Shrimp Task Manager is a task tool built for AI Agents, emphasizing chain-of-thought, reflection, and style consistency. It converts natural language into structured dev tasks with dependency tracking and iterative refinement, enabling agent-like developer behavior in reasoning AI systems.
repos.summary_zh: Shrimp Task Manager 是为 AI 智能体设计的任务管理工具，支持自然语言转结构化开发任务、依赖追踪与迭代优化，强调链式思考、反思和风格一致性，帮助 AI 系统在开发流程中实现类代理的推理行为。
repos.summary_en: Shrimp Task Manager is an MCP server designed for AI agents, converting natural language into structured dev tasks with dependency tracking and iterative refinement. It emphasizes chain-of-thought reasoning, reflection, and style consistency to enable agent-like developer behavior in AI systems.

repos.description: JSON-driven multi-agent  cadence-team development framework with   intelligent CLI orchestration (Gemini/Qwen/Codex),   context-first architecture, and automated workflow   execution
repos.summary_zh: Claude-Code-Workflow 是一个基于 JSON 驱动的 Multi-Agent AI 开发框架，支持智能 CLI 编排（集成 Gemini/Qwen/Codex）、上下文优先架构和自动化工作流执行。通过技能化工作流系统实现团队级协作开发，提供终端仪表盘监控、队列调度及可视化编辑器，适用于复杂 AI 项目协同场景。
repos.summary_en: Claude-Code-Workflow is a JSON-driven multi-agent development framework featuring intelligent CLI orchestration (Gemini/Qwen/Codex), context-first architecture, and automated workflow execution. It enables team-based AI development through skill-based workflows, terminal dashboard monitoring, queue scheduling, and visual workflow editing for complex collaborative projects.

repos.description: A search-first, profile-aware reverse-engineering workspace for AI agents — 735 tools across 36 domains in one MCP server.
repos.summary_zh: jshookmcp 是一个基于 MCP 协议的智能 JavaScript 分析工具平台，集成浏览器自动化、Chrome DevTools 调试、网络监控、智能代码钩子、LLM 驱动的反混淆与 AST 分析等功能。采用搜索优先的上下文优化策略，支持渐进式能力扩展与热加载插件，适用于逆向工程与安全分析场景。
repos.summary_en: jshookmcp is an AI-powered MCP server for intelligent JavaScript analysis, combining browser automation, CDP debugging, network interception, LLM-driven deobfuscation, and AST-level comprehension. It features search-first context efficiency, progressive capability tiers, hot-reload extensibility, and zero-wiring plugin discovery, ideal for reverse engineering and security analysis.

repos.description: ✨ The open-source multi-agent platform. Every agent gets its own computer, desktop, network, and long-term memory.  You can bring your own key, or host your coding agent like Claude Code, Codex and so on.
repos.summary_zh: Memoh 是一个自托管的容器化 AI 智能体平台，支持创建多个具备长期记忆能力的独立机器人。通过 Docker 实现容器级隔离，可连接 Telegram、Discord、Feishu（Lark）、Matrix 等通信渠道，提供图形化配置界面和 MCP 工具调用能力，适用于家庭或团队的多成员协作场景。
repos.summary_en: Memoh is a self-hosted, containerized AI agent platform enabling multiple bots with persistent long-term memory. Each bot runs in isolated containers and integrates with platforms like Telegram, Discord, Feishu (Lark), and Matrix via a web UI, supporting role-based access and cross-platform identity recognition for team or family use.

repos.description: This guide is designed for OpenClaw itself (Agent-facing), not as a traditional human-only hardening checklist.
repos.summary_zh: 本指南专为高权限自主AI代理OpenClaw设计，采用‘代理式零信任架构’范式，从传统静态防御转向动态防护。通过三层防御矩阵（事前行为黑名单、事中权限限制、事后夜间审计）有效应对提示注入、供应链投毒等AI特有风险，支持强推理模型自动部署，显著降低用户配置成本。
repos.summary_en: This guide is tailored for high-privilege autonomous AI agents like OpenClaw, shifting from traditional static defense to 'Agentic Zero-Trust Architecture'. It implements a battle-tested 3-Tier Defense Matrix—pre-action blacklists, in-action permission controls, and post-action nightly audits—to mitigate LLM-specific threats like prompt injection and supply chain poisoning. Designed for seamless integration with strong reasoning models to minimize manual security setup.

repos.description: [GenAI Application Development Framework]  🚀 Build GenAI application quick and easy 💬 Easy to interact with GenAI agent in code using structure data and chained-calls syntax 🧩 Use Event-Driven Flow *TriggerFlow* to manage complex GenAI working logic 🔀 Switch to any model without rewrite application code
repos.summary_zh: Agently 4 是一个生产级 GenAI 应用开发框架，支持结构化数据交互、链式调用语法和事件驱动流（TriggerFlow）编排复杂工作逻辑。它提供契约优先的输出控制、多模型无缝切换能力，并集成会话管理、工具调用与 FastAPI，显著提升 AI 应用的开发效率与稳定性。
repos.summary_en: Agently 4 is a production-grade GenAI application development framework enabling structured data interaction, chained-calls syntax, and event-driven flow orchestration via TriggerFlow. It offers contract-first output control, seamless model switching, session management, tool integration, and FastAPI support to accelerate reliable AI app development.

repos.description: A Python library that provides an easy way to identify devices like mobile phones, tablets and their capabilities by parsing (browser) user agent strings.
repos.summary_zh: user_agents 是一个 Python 库，用于解析浏览器 User-Agent 字符串，精准识别设备类型（手机、平板、PC）及其功能特性（如触屏能力），支持主流移动平台与爬虫检测，依赖 ua-parser 实现高效解析。
repos.summary_en: user_agents is a Python library that parses browser User-Agent strings to accurately identify device types (mobile, tablet, PC) and capabilities (e.g., touch support), supporting major platforms and bot detection via the ua-parser engine.

repos.description: MultiAgentPPT 是一个集成了 A2A（Agent2Agent）+ MCP（Model Context Protocol）+ ADK（Agent Development Kit） 架构的智能化演示文稿生成系统，支持通过多智能体协作和流式并发机制
repos.summary_zh: MultiAgentPPT 是基于 A2A+MCP+ADK 架构的多智能体演示文稿生成系统，通过大纲生成、主题拆分、并行调研和流式汇总等智能体协作，实现高质量PPT的自动化生成，支持实时编辑与下载，具备可扩展性和本地模型适配能力。
repos.summary_en: MultiAgentPPT is a multi-agent system leveraging A2A+MCP+ADK architecture to automate PPT generation through outline creation, topic splitting, parallel research, and streaming synthesis. It supports real-time editing, high-quality content, extensibility, and local model compatibility.

repos.description: [IJCAI 2024] Generate different roles for GPTs to form a collaborative entity for complex tasks.
repos.summary_zh: AutoAgents 是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动智能体生成框架，支持为复杂任务自动生成多角色协作的智能体团队。该框架包含规划器、观察者、工具调用和专家智能体等模块，通过反思机制优化执行流程，已成功应用于谣言验证、贪吃蛇游戏等场景，相关论文已被 IJCAI 2024 接收。
repos.summary_en: AutoAgents is an open-source framework for automatically generating collaborative multi-agent systems based on LLMs to tackle complex tasks. It features a planner, observers, tools, and dynamically generated expert agents with reflection mechanisms. Applications include rumor verification and game automation. The associated paper was accepted at IJCAI 2024.

repos.description: 基于 Claude Code 的长篇网文辅助创作系统，解决 AI 写作中的「遗忘」和「幻觉」问题，支持 200 万字量级 连载创作。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Claude Code 的长篇网文创作辅助系统，通过双 Agent 架构和六维审查机制解决 AI 写作中的遗忘与幻觉问题，支持 200 万字级连载创作，集成 RAG 检索、创意约束系统和追读力机制，确保叙事连贯性与读者粘性。
repos.summary_en: A long-form webnovel writing assistant built on Claude Code, utilizing dual-agent architecture and six-dimensional review mechanisms to address AI writing issues like forgetting and hallucination, supporting serialized creation up to 2 million words with RAG retrieval, creative constraint systems, and reader engagement mechanics.

repos.description: Browser action engine for AI agents. 10× faster, resilient by design.
repos.summary_zh: Actionbook 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的浏览器操作引擎，提供实时更新的网页操作手册和 DOM 结构信息，使智能体能快速、精准地执行网页交互任务。相比传统方法，其性能提升 10 倍，显著降低 LLM 的 token 消耗，并通过语义化 JSON 定义实现高容错性和跨框架兼容性。
repos.summary_en: Actionbook is a browser action engine designed for AI agents, delivering up-to-date action manuals and DOM structure so agents can instantly operate any website without guessing. It enables 10x faster execution, 100x token savings, resilient automation via versioned manuals, and universal compatibility with any LLM or agent framework.

repos.description: Agent-native AI assistant — chat, write, whiteboard, learning, all in one.
repos.summary_zh: YOLO 是一款专为 Obsidian 设计的智能 AI 助手插件，支持 Agent 模式、多窗口对话和知识库问答。通过工具调用与自定义技能实现自动化操作，结合 RAG 技术将整个知识库作为上下文，提供多语言、多模型支持的流畅写作与任务处理体验。
repos.summary_en: YOLO is an intelligent, multilingual AI assistant plugin for Obsidian, featuring Agent mode with tool calling and custom skills, multi-window chat, RAG-powered knowledge base Q&A, and seamless integration with OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and other mainstream LLMs.

repos.description: A more beautiful and easier-to-use alternative to OpenClaw. It features a nicer Web UI, built-in IM support, a sandboxed runtime and channel-based team collaboration. Under the hood, it is powered by a Claude Code–based agent.
repos.summary_zh: Poco 是一款基于 Claude Code 的智能体平台，提供比 OpenClaw 更美观易用的替代方案。核心特性包括安全沙箱环境、多模态文件支持、原生 Claude Code 交互体验（计划模式/提问模式）、内置浏览器与 GitHub 集成、MCP/Skills 扩展能力，以及钉钉/飞书/Telegram 消息集成。采用 Next.js + FastAPI 架构，支持 Docker 一键部署和移动端访问。
repos.summary_en: Poco is a safer and more user-friendly alternative to OpenClaw, powered by a Claude Code-based agent. It features a secure sandboxed runtime, native Claude Code experience (Plan Mode, AskQuestion), built-in browser, GitHub integration, MCP/Skills extensibility, IM integrations (DingTalk/Feishu/Telegram), and multilingual support. Built with Next.js + FastAPI, deployable via Docker with mobile access.

repos.description: Desktop Agent for Any Task
repos.summary_zh: WorkAny 是一款桌面 AI 智能体应用，通过自然语言指令执行复杂任务，支持实时代码生成、工具调用和沙箱环境运行。基于 Claude Agent SDK 构建，集成 MCP 协议与多模型供应商，提供文件管理、文档/网页/表格/幻灯片生成等全场景能力，适用于自动化办公与软件开发。
repos.summary_en: WorkAny is a desktop AI agent that executes tasks via natural language, featuring real-time code generation, sandboxed execution, and workspace management. Built on Claude Agent SDK with MCP support and multi-provider LLM integration, it enables automated file organization, document/web/table/slide generation, and software development workflows.

repos.description: 把灵感、写作、出图、改稿、沉淀放进同一个工作台，让创作从“想到”直接走到“可发布”
repos.summary_zh: ProxyCast 是一个面向创作者的 AI Agent 平台，整合灵感发散、内容生成、素材制作与版本沉淀全流程，支持社媒、短视频、小说、海报等九大创作主题，实现从想法到可发布内容的一站式高效创作。
repos.summary_en: ProxyCast is an AI Agent platform for creators, integrating ideation, content generation, asset creation, and versioning into a unified workspace. It supports nine major creative domains—from social media to novels—enabling seamless workflows from concept to publishable output.

repos.description: Bringing together outstanding artificial intelligence (AI) open source projects from around the world.

repos.summary_en: AI Resource Central is a comprehensive platform aggregating top-tier global AI open-source projects, covering key domains like agents, model training, and multimodal processing. It features curated frameworks such as AutoGPT, MetaGPT, and CrewAI, enabling developers to rapidly access cutting-edge resources and accelerate AI innovation.

repos.summary_en: Awesome AI GPTs is a curated collection of OpenAI GPTs resources, covering prompt engineering, content creation, coding assistance, and data analysis. It offers hot GPTs recommendations, plugin installation guides, knowledge base tools, and security solutions to enhance AI utilization.

repos.summary_en: Claude Code Chinese Development Kit is a zero-threshold AI programming environment tailored for Chinese developers, offering one-click installation with full Chinese localization. It integrates MCP servers, intelligent context management, security scanning, and supports direct access without VPN. The latest version incorporates the Anthropic Hackathon-winning configuration, featuring 9 specialized agents, 7+ skill modules, 10 slash commands, and a complete rule system for end-to-end AI-driven development workflows.

repos.description: BrowserWing turns your browser actions into MCP commands Or Claude Skill, allowing AI agents to control browsers efficiently and reliably. repos.summary_en: BrowserWing is a native browser automation platform that enables AI agents to control browsers via MCP commands or Claude Skills. It offers 26+ HTTP APIs, visual script recording, LLM-powered data extraction, and session management for fast, reliable automation with minimal token overhead.

repos.description: 一个"制造技能的技能"。这个工具自动化了将任意 GitHub 仓库转换为标准化技能的全过程，是扩展 AI Agent 能力的核心工具。

It performs cloud-based scanning, smart RAG extraction of core logic and docs, and generates context bundles without local cloning or complex setup, dramatically improving AI efficiency in handling open-source projects.

repos.description: Lumina Note - A modern Markdown note-taking app with live preview, bidirectional links, and AI assistant

Supports web search, photo capture, template customization, and parsing of PDF/Office documents. Powered by OpenAI API with multimodal input and continuous chat, compatible with third-party forwarding services, fully open-source and free.

repos.description: An open-source AI visualization tool that transforms natural language into Mind Maps, Mermaid diagrams, and Echarts. Turn your ideas into structured visuals instantly.

repos.summary_en: DeepDiagram AI is an open-source intelligent visualization platform powered by Agentic AI and multi-agent orchestration, transforming natural language and multimodal inputs into professional diagrams. It supports six diagram types—mind maps, flowcharts, data charts, architecture diagrams, Mermaid syntax diagrams, and infographics—with context-aware routing, XML-structured output, and interactive editing capabilities for knowledge management, data storytelling, and system design.

repos.description: 一个基于Python和Flask的Web应用，整合了多维度股票分析能力和人工智能辅助决策功能。系统通过AKShare获取股票数据，结合技术分析、基本面分析和资金面分析，为投资者提供全方位的投资决策支持。

repos.summary_en: An AI-powered stock analysis web application built with Python/Flask and LangGraph, integrating multi-source data via AKShare and 13 specialized AI agents (technical, fundamental, capital flow, sentiment). Features 100-point scoring, scenario forecasting, web-searchable Q&A, human-in-the-loop risk approval, MCP tool server, and real-time global market monitoring with a financial portal-style interface.

It leverages a multi-agent system to transform text, screenshots, or URLs into functional code, with integrated Supabase database, real-time preview, and code editor for end-to-end development.

repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个自托管的 NGINX 模块，通过 HTTP 内容协商（Accept: text/markdown）将 HTML 页面转换为 Markdown 格式供 AI 智能体读取。基于 Rust 构建，无需修改现有应用即可为浏览器返回原始 HTML，同时为支持 Markdown 的请求提供纯净内容，降低 AI 处理成本。
repos.summary_en: This project is a self-hostable NGINX module that converts HTML to Markdown via HTTP content negotiation (Accept: text/markdown) for AI agents, powered by a Rust converter. It serves clean Markdown only when requested while preserving original HTML for browsers, enabling seamless agent-friendly content delivery without application changes.

repos.description: A CLI/TUI tool to manage and switch tokens & base URLs for AI agents like Claude, Gemini, and Codex.
repos.summary_zh: agtok 是一个 CLI/TUI 工具，用于集中管理和切换 Claude、Gemini 和 Codex 等 AI 代理的令牌与基础 URL。支持交互式终端界面、预设分组、原子化写入与备份，适用于多环境 AI 工具配置管理。
repos.summary_en: agtok is a CLI/TUI tool for centrally managing and switching tokens and base URLs for AI agents like Claude, Gemini, and Codex. It supports interactive TUI, preset grouping, atomic writes with backups, and seamless configuration switching across environments.

repos.summary_en: oag is a lightweight CLI tool for managing a Git-based AI asset registry, enabling one-command installation and updates of agents, skills, and MCP configs into local environments like Claude, Codex, and OpenCode for consistent setup and faster team collaboration.

repos.description: 🛡️ Workspace file protection plugin for OpenClaw — guards against prompt injection attacks
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw Guard 插件为 OpenClaw AI 代理提供工作区文件防护，有效防御提示注入攻击。通过拦截外部会话的文件操作，自动屏蔽对身份、记忆等关键文件的读写，并将非关键写入重定向至沙箱目录，确保主会话权限隔离与系统安全。
repos.summary_en: The OpenClaw Guard plugin protects OpenClaw AI agents from prompt injection attacks by intercepting file operations in external sessions. It blocks access to critical files like identity and memory, redirecting non-sensitive writes to a sandboxed directory, ensuring secure agent isolation and integrity.
